title: OPEN MIND AC Bridge — loopback HTTP companion + Python host module + dispatcher wiring
brief: Loop-back HTTP companion server (port 18365) that proxies MCP commands to the OPEN MIND Automation Center on a hyperMILL / hyperCAD-S workstation, paired with the host-side prism_ac Python module the spawned scripts import. Closes the missing-middle named in ACSERVER-BRIDGE-AUDIT-2026-05-20.md.

units.title: HyperMillACBridgeEngine — loopback HTTP companion server
units.description: Implements /status, /execute, /job-status, /extract, /optimize routes per HyperMillACServerConfig. Loopback-only (127.0.0.1), CORS restricted to hyperCAD-S panel origins, 1MB body cap, max-concurrent=4, 1h job TTL, pure node:http (no framework).
exit_conditions: All 5 routes return correctly in mock mode
Payload-size guard sends 413 before destroy (P0-1 peer-review fix)
units.completion_note: Built this session. Peer-reviewed FAIL → P0-1 (write-after-destroy race) fixed → PASS.

units.title: prism_ac Python host-side module + installer
units.description: Operators pip-install this once per hyperMILL workstation. TS-side spawns python -c which imports prism_ac, which imports OPEN MIND's hm library. Functions: ping, open_project, geometry_json, operation_tree_json, export_step, close_project, extract_databases, optimize_ppp. Mock-safe when hm absent.
exit_conditions: Every public function returns JSON-serializable dict
protocol_version field in every ok response (P1-2 peer-review fix)
units.completion_note: Built this session. P1-2 fixed (geometry_json mock now uses _ok wrapper).

units.title: prism_cam dispatcher actions for ACServer bridge
units.description: 4 new actions added to camDispatcher: cam_hypermill_drive (op-discriminated call to peer-shipped HyperMILLAutomationBridge — open/geometry/operation_tree/toolpaths/export_step/close); cam_hypermill_ac_bridge_start/stop/status (lifecycle for the HTTP companion server).
exit_conditions: 4 actions in z.enum + 4 case handlers (both verified)
Lazy imports use correct casing (P0-2 peer-review fix)
Drive op-switch covers all 6 ops + default-clause for unknown ops
units.completion_note: Wired this session. P0-2 fixed (HyperMILLAutomationBridge.js casing matches existing peer handlers; Linux CI safe).

units.title: HyperMillACBridgeEngine.test.ts — 31-case vitest suite
units.description: Happy path (5 routes) + failure modes (7 cases: missing fields, bad JSON, unknown route/job, oversize) + adversarial (5 cases: non-loopback bind, malformed JSON, oversize, invalid port, uptime monotonicity) + lifecycle (4 cases: isRunning/double-start/double-stop/listJobs) + PRISM_HYPERMILL_LIVE scaffold (1 case, skipped by default).
exit_conditions: Real TCP round-trips (not just method calls)
units.completion_note: Built this session. 31 cases — well above the floor.
